name: hashspan
description: OpenTelemetry tracing for on-chain transactions sent by AI agents and other services.

scripts.test:integrations: pnpm --dir integrations typecheck && pnpm --dir integrations test
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.check:packages: pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec publint --strict && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec attw --pack . --profile node16
scripts.api:check: pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec api-extractor run
scripts.api:update: pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec api-extractor run --local

pnpm.//: tar: prool pins tar@7.2.0 but never imports it (https://github.com/wevm/prool/issues/112). Remove once prool drops or bumps it. shell-quote: @changesets/cli's launch-editor allows ^1.10.0, the lockfile had 1.10.0 (GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv, patched in 1.11.0); remove once the lockfile resolves 1.11.0 or later without it. launch-editor: @changesets/cli allows ^2.x, the lockfile had 2.14.1 (GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm, patched in 2.14.2); remove once the lockfile resolves 2.14.2 or later without it.
